description: A CSV with only a header row and zero data rows -- the case where a PM uploads an empty export or a file that failed to render. Single-file fixture; there is no 'new' side.
notes: IngestionPipeline.run() raises PipelineError rather than returning a 0-activity schedule -- headers are recognized (all 9 columns map cleanly) but there are no rows to normalize, and the pipeline's own 'no chunks, no activities' guard treats that as an error rather than a silent empty result. This is the correct current behaviour for brief §28's pre-flight check (an empty file should not proceed to analysis pretending everything is fine) -- this fixture exists so a future change doesn't accidentally make an empty upload succeed silently.
